author: zhenbinwu
body:
#### PR description:

In previous PRs, the KMTF firmware was updated to use Z and slope information for barrel muon stubs, reusing the bits originally assigned to the stubs' eta1/eta2 fields. However, carrying these changes over to the emulator introduced a bug affecting TPS stubs, as reported in [CMSSW issue #52096](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/52096).

This PR fixes the issue.

#### PR validation:

It recovered the tkMuon efficiency in the barrel region.
title: [L1GMT]  Fix stub of Barrel Muon KMTF
